title: BillingVibesChargeCreateRequest
description: billing.vibes-charge-create-request@1: body of POST /api/v1/vibes/charges, sent from the app's server with its app token (capability billing.vibes.charge). amount is whole Vibes. reference is the app's idempotency key: a replay with the same reference and body returns the same charge. return_url is optional. The app token decides the project, the sandbox environment and the owner-set limits.

amount.description: Price in whole Vibes, a positive integer; never a fraction or a nano-USD amount.

description.description: What the person is paying for.

reference.description: The app's own reference; it is the idempotency key.

return_url.description: Where the browser returns after paying. Optional; the app may instead poll the charge or wait for the webhook.
